title: Momentum premium by sector (empirical Bayes pooling)
description: Sector-specific momentum slopes with empirical-Bayes shrinkage (fast), compared with complete and no pooling.
question: factors
method_note: Normal-normal empirical Bayes: the population mean and between-sector variance are estimated by EM on the marginal likelihood; each sector's slope is a precision-weighted mix of its own OLS and the mean. Caveat: the universe is today's constituents (membership history starts 2026-10), so early years carry survivorship bias; read the premium as an upper bound.

result.verdict: partial pooling is worse than linear-Gaussian baseline on CRPS (mean 0.04871 vs 0.04871); point forecast: partial pooling does not significantly beat linear baseline (DM p = 0.777)

study.name: Momentum premium by sector (empirical Bayes pooling)
